name: point-left
prompt: Correct an animation atlas of the approved whole mascot. EXACT same boy, face, hand-painted cartoon style, navy gold-arrow cap, burgundy vest, rolled cream sleeves, toolbelt. EIGHT FULL COMPLETE WAIST-UP ACTORS, FOUR COLUMNS TWO ROWS on transparent. IMPORTANT make actors SMALLER inside cells: each WHOLE ACTOR including extended arm must fit within the central 75% of its cell, with AT LEAST 35px transparent gutter on left/right and between rows. FULL rounded elbows, fingertips, cap and bottom jeans must have transparent margin all round. No figure may touch image edges or another figure. Match same fixed camera and body size for all8. Horizontal silver central belt buckle unobscured every frame. Closed-mouth smile. Never cropped limbs. No text, labels, effects, cells or borders. This is a sequence not unrelated poses. Horizontal pointing to viewer's LEFT. Use the arm on viewer's LEFT, gaze turns LEFT then head LEFT, arm lifts gradually from belt to chest then extends OUTWARD LEFT. Keep torso and belt frontal, never mirror the uniform. 0 neutral,1 pupils left,2 head starts left and elbow slightly lifts,3 hand halfway up,4 index extends halfway left,5 arm nearly extended,6 full left point,7 hold.
